theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Require Large Investments? Think Again
body: You can start investing with small amounts through systematic approaches. Regular contributions build wealth over time without needing lump sums.
caption: Mutual funds are accessible to everyone, regardless of starting capital. Small, consistent steps lead to meaningful growth. Misconceptions often prevent people from exploring investment options. #MutualFundMyths #InvestmentBasics #SmallStepsCount #WealthBuilding #DebunkingMyths
